title: 海岸養灘工程
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「養灘幾何與方量」與「固體量與孔隙」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nourishment geometry and volume" and "Solid quantity and porosity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「養灘幾何與方量」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nourishment geometry and volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。矩形示意適合練習尺寸核對，真實海灘有斜坡與沿岸變化，需要逐剖面積分；初始灘寬也不保證風浪重塑後仍維持相同位置。 假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「養灘幾何與方量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. Delivered loose volume need not equal completed profile volume. A rectangular illustration helps check dimensions, but a real beach varies alongshore and across its slopes and requires section integration; initial width does not guarantee the same shoreline after wave-driven redistribution. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nourishment geometry and volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「養灘幾何與方量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nourishment geometry and volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 養灘幾何與方量
knowledge.text: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。矩形示意適合練習尺寸核對，真實海灘有斜坡與沿岸變化，需要逐剖面積分；初始灘寬也不保證風浪重塑後仍維持相同位置。
knowledge.textEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. Delivered loose volume need not equal completed profile volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「海岸養灘工程」的「養灘幾何與方量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海岸水槽與港區實驗」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Nourishment geometry and volume: mechanism and system paths” in “Beach nourishment”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Coastal flume and harbor experiments” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「養灘幾何與方量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nourishment geometry and volume" is correct?
options: 施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。
養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。
孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
optionsEn: The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season.
Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum.
Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
quiz.explanation: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「養灘幾何與方量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nourishment geometry and volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「養灘幾何與方量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nourishment geometry and volume", which statement holds?
options: 新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。
乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.
Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「養灘幾何與方量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nourishment geometry and volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。
knowledge.textEn: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。
knowledge.textEn: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「養灘幾何與方量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nourishment geometry and volume"?
options: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。
optionsEn: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
quiz.explanation: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「養灘幾何與方量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nourishment geometry and volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。表面變寬不能單獨證明整個活動剖面已增加足夠儲砂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss. Missing submerged sections conceal redistributed sand, and a wider dry beach alone does not establish added storage across the active profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。表面變寬不能單獨證明整個活動剖面已增加足夠儲砂。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss. Missing submerged sections conceal redistributed sand, and a wider dry beach alone does not establish added storage across the active profile.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「養灘幾何與方量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nourishment geometry and volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。
孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss.
Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
quiz.explanation: 用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 固體量與孔隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Solid quantity and porosity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「固體量與孔隙」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solid quantity and porosity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 養灘材料以固體顆粒量追蹤比較穩定，因為排水及壓密會改變外觀體積。乾質量換算需用顆粒密度而非濕容重，孔隙率亦須對應相同材料狀態；黏土團塊或貝殼會使單一密度近似失準，不能只憑船艙刻度結算泥沙收支。 假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「固體量與孔隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tracking solid grains helps distinguish material movement from drainage and compaction. Dry-mass conversion requires grain density rather than wet bulk density, with porosity defined for the same condition. Clay aggregates or shells can invalidate a single-density approximation, so hopper readings alone cannot close the sediment balance. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Solid quantity and porosity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「固體量與孔隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Solid quantity and porosity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 固體量與孔隙
knowledge.text: 養灘材料以固體顆粒量追蹤比較穩定，因為排水及壓密會改變外觀體積。乾質量換算需用顆粒密度而非濕容重，孔隙率亦須對應相同材料狀態；黏土團塊或貝殼會使單一密度近似失準，不能只憑船艙刻度結算泥沙收支。
knowledge.textEn: Tracking solid grains helps distinguish material movement from drainage and compaction. Dry-mass conversion requires grain density rather than wet bulk density, with porosity defined for the same condition.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「固體量與孔隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Solid quantity and porosity" is correct?
options: 孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。
養灘材料以固體顆粒量追蹤比較穩定，因為排水及壓密會改變外觀體積。
optionsEn: Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
Tracking solid grains helps distinguish material movement from drainage and compaction.
quiz.explanation: 養灘材料以固體顆粒量追蹤比較穩定，因為排水及壓密會改變外觀體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tracking solid grains helps distinguish material movement from drainage and compaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 固體量與孔隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Solid quantity and porosity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固體量與孔隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Solid quantity and porosity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「固體量與孔隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Solid quantity and porosity", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。
暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month.
All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 固體量與孔隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Solid quantity and porosity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固體量與孔隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Solid quantity and porosity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。
knowledge.textEn: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。
knowledge.textEn: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space.

quiz.question: 要驗證「固體量與孔隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Solid quantity and porosity"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates.
An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
quiz.explanation: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 固體量與孔隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Solid quantity and porosity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固體量與孔隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Solid quantity and porosity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。不同批次含貝殼與細料時，沿用同一密度也可能製造不存在的收支缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Variable shell and fine content also makes a single borrowed density create an artificial deficit in the sediment budget. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。不同批次含貝殼與細料時，沿用同一密度也可能製造不存在的收支缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Variable shell and fine content also makes a single borrowed density create an artificial deficit in the sediment budget.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「固體量與孔隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Solid quantity and porosity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。
若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss.
quiz.explanation: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
